mentions.name: runchat.app
mentions.description: A visual canvas tool for creative workflow automation with generative AI. It supports open-ended exploration and experimentation with models on fal, plus automation of tasks like image processing and web scraping. Its UI is generated on the fly (ephemeral interfaces) to suit a specific design task, enabling workflows to be built from self-contained modular React components.
mentions.problem: Giving creatives more control over generative AI.
mentions.audience: Creatives who want more control over generative AI
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently working on a tool for creative workflow automation called runchat.app with the goal of giving creatives more control over gen ai. Its a jeckyl and hyde visual canvas  that can be used for open ended exploration and experimentation with models on fal as well as automation of things like image processing or web scraping.
